## Description and Rationale

We are a couple students studying ML who are interested in applying our skills to real-world data. This is an excellent opportunity to work with a large dataset.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: United States
* Number of team members: 2

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(gt)

gt(tibble::tribble(
  ~id,  ~forename, ~surname,  ~affiliation,
   1L,    "Sandy",    "Tam", "Independent",
   2L, "Guanghan",     "Li", "Independent"
)
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
```
